name: CRISPR Delivery Strategy Advisor
description: Recommends and ranks CRISPR delivery methods (lipofection, electroporation, RNP, AAV, lentiviral, LNP, eVLP, etc.) for a given cell type and Cas variant, with rationale, KB citations, and key considerations. Also accepts the upstream Construction File Builder output as a `construct` object — extracts cell_type/cas_variant/edit_type from it and cross-checks the builder's kit_choice against the top delivery recommendation.

inputs.name: cell_type
inputs.description: The target cell type (e.g. 'HEK293', 'primary T cells', 'neurons', 'iPSCs', 'hepatocytes'). Required unless `construct` is provided.

inputs.name: cas_variant
inputs.description: The CRISPR-Cas variant (e.g. 'SpCas9', 'SaCas9', 'CBE4max', 'PE2'). Required unless `construct` is provided.

inputs.name: edit_type
inputs.description: The type of genome edit ('knockout', 'knock-in', 'base edit', 'prime edit'). Defaults to 'knockout'.

inputs.name: construct
inputs.description: Upstream Construction File Builder output. Must include cell_type and cas_variant. Optional fields that are consumed when present: edit_type, kit_choice (or vector_backbone) for consistency check, off_target_risk_profile to bias toward transient delivery under high off-target burden. Explicit kwargs override fields in construct.

outputs.description: Ranked delivery methods with suitability, rationale, KB citations, and key considerations; plus a top recommendation, general advice, a kit_choice_consistency sanity-check (null-filled when no kit_choice is provided), and excluded_by_prefilter when applicable.

ranked_methods.rationale: HEK293 is a canonical easy-to-transfect adherent line; plasmid lipofection of SpCas9 is cheap, simple, and high-efficiency.
Pre-assembled Cas9 RNP gives transient editing with minimal off-target activity due to fast protein clearance.
Stable integration is unnecessary for a simple knockout and adds insertional mutagenesis risk.

result.general_advice: For HEK293 SpCas9 knockouts, lipofection is the simplest and most cost-effective option. Use RNP electroporation if off-target minimization is critical.

ranked_methods.rationale: HEK293 is highly transfectable; simple plasmid lipofection of SpCas9 suffices for a knockout.
Matches the upstream kit_choice (lentiCRISPRv2), but integration is unnecessary for a transient knockout in an easy line.
key_considerations: Integration risk not justified for simple KO

ranked_methods.rationale: Transient RNP minimizes off-target exposure further.

result.general_advice: For TP53 KO in HEK293, lipofection is simpler than lentiviral transduction. If the lentiCRISPRv2 kit is already in hand and a stable pool is desired, the kit_choice is workable but not optimal for a transient knockout.

kit_choice_consistency.note: Upstream chose lentiCRISPRv2 (integrating), but for HEK293 SpCas9 knockout, transient lipofection or RNP is preferred over a lentiviral vector — integration is unnecessary and adds off-target risk.
